questions.prompt: Which Container Apps change creates a new revision?

options.text: Changing the container image in the app template
Changing only an existing secret value
options.explanation: Secret values are application-scoped; revisions may need restarting to consume changes.
Changing the identity does not itself create a new revision.

questions.prompt: A Container App has healthy revisions old and new. A canary must keep both versions active while sending 10% of HTTP ingress requests to new and the remaining traffic to old. Which complete configuration meets this requirement?

options.text: Multiple revision mode; old weight 90, new weight 10.
options.explanation: Multiple mode permits both revisions to remain active, and these weights implement the required split.

options.text: Single revision mode; old weight 90, new weight 10.
options.explanation: Single mode does not maintain the two active versions required for steady canary traffic splitting.

options.text: Multiple revision mode; old weight 10, new weight 90.
options.explanation: Both versions can be active, but this sends 90% rather than 10% to new.

options.text: Multiple revision mode; old weight 100, new weight 0.
options.explanation: Both versions can be active, but the new revision receives none of the required canary traffic.

questions.prompt: A Container App has one healthy active revision receiving 100% of traffic. External HTTP ingress is enabled, and clients reach its HTTPS endpoint. The process listens on 0.0.0.0:8080, but ingress targetPort is 80 and requests fail to reach the process. Which configuration change addresses this mismatch?

options.explanation: Ingress must forward requests to the port where the process listens; the current target 80 is incorrect.

options.text: Set ingress allowInsecure to true while retaining targetPort 80.
options.explanation: This permits HTTP in addition to HTTPS; it does not fix forwarding to the wrong container port.

options.text: Increase maximum replicas while retaining targetPort 80.
options.explanation: Additional replicas with the same port mismatch still receive forwarding to the wrong port.

options.text: Reapply a traffic weight of 100 to the active revision while retaining targetPort 80.
options.explanation: The revision already receives all traffic. Reapplying the weight does not change the incorrect target port.
